title: The House of the Dead
overview:
They're Dead They Just Don't Know It Yet

Your job: play teacher using strategically placed rounds of hot lead. The arcade monster hit has risen on Sega Saturn. Load your trusty 12 gauge and dissect every rotting zombie, beefed-up cadaver and killer monkey experiment that stumbles your way. Just don't miss; these maggot-ridden mummies haven't had a good meal in years.

- A faithful conversion of the arcade original - dangling intestine for dangling intestine.
- Staggering "graphic" realism - rotting flesh actually rips apart with each round.
- Exclusive gameplay modes not found in the arcade - try Saturn Mode or Boss Mode.
- 4 chapters with branching storylines. Have a new massacre for breakfast, lunch and dinner.
- Blow away more than 11 types of hideous enemies.
